text:
nate-sales: Heads up — Meridian wants a joint POC targeted for week of Apr 13. Scope: VPC peering + SAML SSO, Dedicated capacity initially, potential PHI-ish dataset. Need eng/arch + security + pricing input and a short runbook. Who can own the technical prewire?

maria-partner: Adding Meridian PM (cc). They uploaded SSO metadata and questionnaire: https://drive.company/meridian/poc — they prefer Dedicated but will consider Private if required.

emily-solutions: Quick Qs for scope: expected sustained qps vs peak? token retention/telemetry retention? If PHI is confirmed, we should push for Private (VPC + BYOK/HSM).

james-arch: Notes from infra POV: two viable patterns — (A) shared tenant w/ strict routing + customer subnet egress OR (B) fully isolated tenant (safer). For PHI, B + Private deployment. For 100 qps burst estimate: ~4 x A100-ish equiv for low-latency 16k context depending on model. Batch size 8–12 recommended.

anika-sec: Security checklist we need asap: completed vendor questionnaire, SOC2 report, dataflow diagram, SAML metadata, KMS/BYOK plan, egress IPs, and audit log retention policy. I can start pre-filling the questionnaire. Who owns the contact at Meridian for security?

raj-pricing: Pricing heads-up: Dedicated reserved 3mo commit vs hosted payg fallback. Rough ballpark to share with GTM: reserved ~ $24k/month (model/hw dependent) + token charges for hosted fallback. I'll produce two skus: (1) Dedicated commit + support, (2) Private on-prem quote. Need expected monthly tokens and target SLA.

maria-partner: Meridian said 200k tokens/month expected initially, audit log retention = 1 year, compliance team wants proof of encryption at rest and transit. Contact: alice.meridian@meridian.com (security lead).

nate-sales: Action items: James -> runbook skeleton + provisioning commands. Anika -> start questionnaire prefills & reach out to Alice. Raj -> pricing options by EOD Fri. Emily -> confirm perf/throughput with Meridian PM. I'll coordinate schedule.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Apr 3 10:00am PT — "Meridian joint POC prewire". Invite sent to participants.

james-arch: Draft runbook snippet (initial):
```bash
# runbook: meridian joint poc - skeleton
1) Provision dedicated pool:
   redwood provision dedicated --region us-west-2 --gpus 4 --tenant meridian-poc
2) Configure networking:
   add-vpc-peering --from redwood-vpc --to meridian-vpc --allow-egress 52.23.45.0/24
3) Upload SAML metadata and test login:
   redwood saml upload --tenant meridian-poc --file meridian-saml.xml
4) Enable audit logs and set retention:
   redwood audit configure --tenant meridian-poc --retention 365d
```

anika-sec: I'll DM @maria-partner and Alice to get SAML metadata and updated dataflow. Will also attach SOC2 cert and a redacted dataflow diagram to the questionnaire.

raj-pricing: Will put two line items in the quote: 3mo reserved + optional hosted fallback throttle. Also adding telemetry export costs if they want raw logs forwarded.

maria-partner: :thumbsup: thanks all — Meridian preferred go/no-go after prewire. Nate, can you confirm decision authority from Meridian for commit?

nate-sales: I have verbal okay from their Head of Product for a 90-day pilot; legal will sign the MSA. I'll push for a written confirmation by EOD tomorrow.

emily-solutions: One more note — if they want model determinism/regression checks we should add a small eval harness (prompt set) to run after deployment. I'll draft a minimal test plan.

james-arch: I'll post the full runbook draft in the doc linked below once done: https://redwood.ai/internal/pocs/meridian/runbook — ping me for edits.

anika-sec: I'll start the questionnaire prefill and tag answers that need Meridian confirmation.

maria-partner: Great — setting expectation with Meridian that prewire + security review takes ~7 business days.

nate-sales: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, thumbs up on this thread and I'll follow up with the calendar invite + tracker in Asana.

maria-partner: :white_check_mark:
